title: Day 0
body:
6:17 pm

Test post. Passed the day in CP in Blue Tokai. They really do just let you sit here without asking you to leave. It's been me and two others with rucksacks who've been holding down our spots since like, 1 pm. I set this website up in that time. 

Bus from Kashmiri Gate at 9:15 pm today. Will head around 8:00 pm, should reach by 8:30. Got some protein bars. Need to find bananas if I can. Water. And a head pillow thing if I come across.

Testing images. Cascara from Blue Tokai. 

![](assets/images/cascara.png)

Testing [links](https://codepen.io/bitmap/pen/AzowBq)



Went to Cafe MRP for quick drinks with brother. Did not break the bank, decent vibes to hang around for a bit. Another recommendation I got was Saqi Bar at Hotel Alka, but did not end up going. For the next time I have time to kill in CP.
